new_entities.name: Propulsion, suspension, steering and braking systems

obligations.subject: n1
obligations.response: the vehicle shall meet the following requirements
obligations.ears: After each impact test made in accordance with the conditions and procedure specified in annex 3 to this Regulation, the vehicle shall meet the following requirements.

obligations.subject: n2
obligations.response: shall continue to operate correctly and to remain visible
obligations.ears: After each impact test made in accordance with the conditions and procedure specified in annex 3 to this Regulation, the lighting and signalling devices shall continue to operate correctly and to remain visible.

obligations.subject: n2
obligations.response: it may be corrected to conform to the required specifications
obligations.exception: provided this can be done by the normal means of adjustment
obligations.ears: When the adjustment of the factory-fitted lighting devices is disturbed after the impact test, the adjustment may be corrected to conform to the required specifications, provided this can be done by the normal means of adjustment.

obligations.subject: n2
obligations.response: Bulbs may be replaced
obligations.ears: When filament failure occurs after the impact test, bulbs may be replaced.

obligations.subject: n3
obligations.response: shall be operable in the normal manner; in addition, the side doors of the vehicle shall not be able to open under the effect of the impact
obligations.ears: After each impact test, the vehicle's bonnet (hood), boot lid (trunk lid) and doors shall be operable in the normal manner, and the side doors of the vehicle shall not be able to open under the effect of the impact.

derived.text: After each impact test, the vehicle's bonnet (hood), boot lid (trunk lid) and doors shall be operable in the normal manner.
After each impact test, the side doors of the vehicle shall not be able to open under the effect of the impact.

obligations.subject: n4
obligations.response: shall have neither leaks nor constricted fluid passages which prevent normal functioning; their sealing devices and caps shall be operable in the normal manner
obligations.ears: After each impact test, the vehicle's fuel and cooling systems shall have neither leaks nor constricted fluid passages which prevent normal functioning, and their sealing devices and caps shall be operable in the normal manner.

derived.text: After each impact test, the vehicle's fuel and cooling systems shall have neither leaks nor constricted fluid passages which prevent normal functioning.
After each impact test, the sealing devices and caps of the vehicle's fuel and cooling systems shall be operable in the normal manner.

obligations.subject: n5
obligations.response: shall not suffer any damage or displacement which would prevent its normal function
obligations.ears: After each impact test, the vehicle's exhaust system shall not suffer any damage or displacement which would prevent its normal function.

obligations.subject: n6
obligations.response: shall remain in adjustment and shall operate in a normal manner
obligations.ears: After each impact test, the vehicle's propulsion, suspension (including tyres), steering and braking systems shall remain in adjustment and shall operate in a normal manner.

derived.text: After each impact test, the vehicle's propulsion, suspension (including tyres), steering and braking systems shall remain in adjustment.
After each impact test, the vehicle's propulsion, suspension (including tyres), steering and braking systems shall operate in a normal manner.

obligations.subject: n6
obligations.response: They may become damaged, disoriented or broken
obligations.exception: as long as the basic braking and steering performance are still intact
obligations.ears: When an impact is carried out according to Annex 3, the propulsion, suspension, steering and braking systems may become damaged, disoriented or broken as long as the basic braking and steering performance are still intact.

obligations.subject: e7
obligations.response: shall be notified to the administrative department which approved the vehicle type
obligations.ears: When the vehicle type is modified, every modification shall be notified to the administrative department which approved the vehicle type.

obligations.subject: n7
obligations.response: consider that the modifications made are unlikely to have appreciable adverse effects, and that in any case the vehicle still complies with the requirements; or require a further test report from the technical service responsible for conducting the tests
obligations.ears: When a modification is notified, the department may either consider that the modifications made are unlikely to have appreciable adverse effects and that in any case the vehicle still complies with the requirements, or require a further test report from the technical service responsible for conducting the tests.

obligations.subject: e1
obligations.response: shall be communicated by the procedure specified in paragraph 5.3. above to the Parties to the Agreement which apply this Regulation
obligations.ears: The confirmation or refusal of approval, specifying the alterations, shall be communicated by the procedure specified in paragraph 5.3. above to the Parties to the Agreement which apply this Regulation.

obligations.subject: n1
obligations.response: shall conform to the vehicle type approved, particularly as regards features which influence the behaviour of the parts of the structure and the components affected by impact
obligations.ears: Every vehicle bearing an approval mark as prescribed under this Regulation shall conform to the vehicle type approved, particularly as regards features which influence the behaviour of the parts of the structure and the components affected by impact.

obligations.subject: n1
obligations.response: a sufficient number of random checks shall be made on seriallymanufactured vehicles bearing the approval mark required by this Regulation
obligations.ears: In order to verify conformity as prescribed in paragraph 8.1. above, a sufficient number of random checks shall be made on seriallymanufactured vehicles bearing the approval mark required by this Regulation.

obligations.subject: n1
obligations.response: the said checks shall be confined to measurements
obligations.ears: As a general rule, the conformity of production checks shall be confined to measurements.

obligations.subject: n1
obligations.response: the vehicles shall, if necessary, be subjected to the checks prescribed in paragraph 6. above
obligations.ears: When necessary, the vehicles shall be subjected to the checks prescribed in paragraph 6. above.

obligations.subject: e1
obligations.response: may be withdrawn
obligations.ears: If the requirement laid down in paragraph 8.1. above is not complied with or if the vehicle has failed to pass the tests prescribed in paragraph 6. above, the approval granted in respect of a vehicle type pursuant to this Regulation may be withdrawn.

obligations.subject: n8
obligations.response: shall forthwith so notify the other Contracting Parties to the Agreement which apply this Regulation, by means of a copy of the approval form bearing at the end, in large letters, the signed and dated annotation "APPROVAL WITHDRAWN"
obligations.ears: If a Party to the Agreement which applies this Regulation withdraws an approval it has previously granted, it shall forthwith so notify the other Contracting Parties to the Agreement which apply this Regulation, by means of a copy of the approval form bearing at the end, in large letters, the signed and dated annotation "APPROVAL WITHDRAWN".

obligations.subject: n9
obligations.response: he shall so inform the authority which granted the approval
obligations.ears: If the holder of the approval completely ceases production of a vehicle approved in accordance with this Regulation, he shall so inform the authority which granted the approval.

obligations.subject: n7
obligations.response: shall inform thereof the other Parties to the Agreement applying this Regulation, by means of a copy of the approval form bearing at the end, in large letters, the signed and dated annotation "PRODUCTION DISCONTINUED"
obligations.ears: Upon receiving the relevant communication, that authority shall inform thereof the other Parties to the Agreement applying this Regulation, by means of a copy of the approval form bearing at the end, in large letters, the signed and dated annotation "PRODUCTION DISCONTINUED".
